name: Alphalete - Live Indexation Audit 2026-07-24
body:
> Audit · Alphalete · 2026-07-24

Companions: `Alphalete_GSC_NotIndexed_Dashboard_2026-07-24.pdf`, `Alphalete_Indexation_Audit_RawData_2026-07-24.csv`, `Alphalete_Indexation_Redirect_Map_2026-07-24.txt` (same folder)

# Summary
A two-part July 24 package. The **GSC Not-Indexed Dashboard** (GSC data dated Jul 10) showed only 19 of 150 known URLs indexed (12.7%). The **Live Indexation Audit** then checked all 124 not-indexed URLs live with a Googlebot user agent and concluded: this is not a noindex problem.

# Dashboard (GSC, Jul 10 data)
- 131 not indexed, 19 indexed, 5 reasons, 150 known.
- Reasons: Discovered-not-indexed 101, Crawled-not-indexed 21, 404 7, Page with redirect 1, noindex 1.
- The Discovered bucket was almost entirely programmatic city and service pages (drain 15, hydro 9, trenchless 30, commercial 22, plus core pages).

# Live audit findings
- Of 124 URLs: 27 live 200, 29 301 redirects, 72 404, 5 redirect-to-404 chains, 0 live noindex.
- No meta robots noindex (except intentional `/thank-you/`), no X-Robots-Tag, no robots.txt block, no cloaking; rendered DOM matched raw source.
- Sitemap `sitemap_index.xml` to `sitemap.xml` with 128 live URLs, GSC Sitemaps "Success" (read Jul 23).
- Canonicals all self-referencing.
- GSC "not indexed" labels were mostly stale memory of the old structure. Live pages showed "URL is unknown to Google" while Test Live URL passed: a discovery and crawl-budget delay.

# Remediation order (from the file)
1. Fix the 5 redirect-to-404 chains first (repoint 301s to live pages).
2. Rebuild or leave as 404/410 the retired `-co` and old service-area URLs, depending on whether the city is a target.
3. Keep the sitemap to live 200 URLs only.
4. Add crawlable internal links from indexed hubs to the 26 live-but-uncrawled pages.
5. Improve uniqueness on templated pages, then Test Live URL and Request Indexing.

# Files in this group
- `Alphalete_Indexation_Audit_RawData_2026-07-24.csv`: per-URL status, robots, canonical and sitemap flag for both user agents (128 rows).
- `Alphalete_Indexation_Redirect_Map_2026-07-24.txt`: final destination for every redirect.
- `test_cb.html` and `test_out.html` in the project root are cache-buster page captures from the same evening (no note).
